title: **MVN Group Signs Design Consultancy Contract for My Dinh PEAR – PEAR 3 and the Overall Project Sales Documentation**
description: MVN Group Signs Design Consultancy Contract with SSG Group for My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3 and the Overall Project Sales Documentation. This milestone marks a significant step forward in affirming MVN Group’s expertise in architectural consultancy, product development, and its commitment to accompanying large-scale high-rise real estate projects.
author: MVN Group
content:
On May 26, 2025, in Hanoi, Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG, a member of SSG Group, held a signing ceremony with MVN Architecture & Construction Investment Joint Stock Company (MVN Group) for the design consultancy package for My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3 and the overall project sales documentation.

This marks an important milestone in the cooperation between the two companies, further demonstrating the Client’s confidence in MVN Group’s professional expertise, practical experience, and design thinking in the development of high-rise projects.

 

 

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Project: My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3
Location: 01 Chau Van Liem, Nam Tu Liem District, Hanoi, Vietnam
Site Area: 3.8 hectares
Overall Site Coverage: 24.87%
Residential Building Coverage: 18.25%
Residential Gross Floor Area: 15,992 m²
Scale: 951 apartments

The project forms part of the overall My Dinh PEAR development, where PEARL 1 and PEARL 2 have already been completed, providing an important foundation for the continued development of PEARL 3 and the completion of the project’s overall identity.

With its strategic location, scale, and established product system, the development of PEARL 3 and the overall project sales documentation requires a high level of consistency in architecture, visual identity, functionality, and the ability to communicate the project’s value to the market.

LEADERSHIP REPRESENTATIVES FROM BOTH COMPANIES ATTEND THE SIGNING CEREMONY

The signing ceremony was attended by:

  • Mr. Phan Le Anh – General Director of Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG, Member of the Board of Directors of SSG Group.

  • Mr. Hoang Huu Son – Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG, a member of SSG Group.

  • Mr. Truong Anh Vuong – General Director of MVN Architecture & Construction Investment Joint Stock Company (MVN Group).

  • Mr. Do Tan Dat – Project Director of MVN Architecture & Construction Investment Joint Stock Company (MVN Group).

The presence of the leadership teams from both companies demonstrates the importance placed on the project while establishing a strong foundation for close coordination throughout the stages of research, concept development, design, and completion of the sales documentation.

INSIGHTS FROM THE CLIENT – SSG

Throughout the process of discussion, research, and design development, MVN’s approach successfully met the Client’s expectations, demonstrating the team’s ability to translate project requirements into a product that balances architectural quality, aesthetics, functionality, and operational efficiency.

Mr. Phan Le Anh – General Director of Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG, Member of the Board of Directors of SSG Group:

“We are very satisfied with and highly appreciate the professional expertise and practical experience of the MVN Group team, particularly in the design of high-rise residential projects.”

Ms. Ho Thi Thuy Phuong – Head of Sales Department, Vietnam Petroleum Real Estate Joint Stock Company – SSG:

“We highly appreciate MVN Group’s professional expertise, collaborative spirit, and working efficiency.”

According to Ms. Phuong, MVN not only demonstrates strong architectural and aesthetic thinking, but also approaches the project from the perspective of product development and market needs, with a strong focus on functionality, customer experience, and commercial potential.

The team’s proactive coordination, prompt responses, and ability to effectively incorporate practical requirements have contributed to refining the design approach toward a solution that is aesthetically appealing, market-oriented, and highly applicable.

In addition to its practical project experience, MVN’s professional awards and achievements in the field of high-rise architecture have also served as an important basis for the Client’s assessment of the consultancy team’s capabilities.

This recognition serves as strong motivation for MVN to further develop its professional strengths and continue working alongside SSG in the development of My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3, as well as in completing the overall identity of the project.

CREATING VALUE FROM ARCHITECTURE TO REAL ESTATE PRODUCTS

 

 

For MVN Group, designing a real estate project is not simply a matter of architectural form. It is a comprehensive process that considers functionality, user experience, product value, and investment efficiency.

For PEARL 3, MVN aims to develop a design approach that is modern, distinctive, functionally optimized, and focused on enhancing product value, while ensuring harmony with the completed PEARL 1 and PEARL 2 developments.

Alongside the design consultancy, the overall project sales documentation will be developed with a consistent visual and information system, clearly communicating the project’s key values to customers and the market.

This approach brings together architecture – visual identity – product information – market-oriented thinking, creating a coherent system of communication and project identity across the entire development.

CONTINUING THE JOURNEY OF PARTNERING ON LARGE-SCALE PROJECTS

With a team of experienced architects, engineers, and specialists, MVN Group is committed to creating architectural solutions that are high-quality, distinctive, and built around long-term value.

Being selected by SSG to undertake the design consultancy package for My Dinh PEAR – PEARL 3 and the overall project sales documentation represents an important milestone, further affirming MVN’s capabilities in high-rise architectural design and real estate product development.

MVN Group sincerely appreciates the trust placed in us by SSG Group and is committed to contributing our professional expertise, sense of responsibility, and creative thinking toward a product that delivers on the following values:

ARCHITECTURE – AESTHETICS – FUNCTIONALITY – QUALITY – COMMERCIAL EFFICIENCY
